name: Disable Telnet Access
description: Telnet transmits data in plaintext, including credentials, making it vulnerable to interception. Management access must use encrypted protocols only.

fix_commands.cisco:
line vty 0 15
 no transport input telnet
 transport input ssh
fix_commands.fortinet:
config system global
 set admin-telnet disable
end
fix_commands.juniper:
delete system services telnet
set system services ssh

name: Enforce SSH Version 2
description: SSH version 1 has known vulnerabilities. Only SSHv2 should be permitted for encrypted management access.

fix_commands.fortinet:
config system global
 set admin-ssh-v1 disable
end
fix_commands.juniper: set system services ssh protocol-version v2

name: Disable HTTP Management Server
description: HTTP transmits management traffic unencrypted. The HTTP server must be disabled in favor of HTTPS.

fix_commands.fortinet:
config system global
 set admin-http enable-redirect
end

name: Configure Login Banner
description: A warning banner must be displayed before login to inform unauthorized users and satisfy legal requirements.

fix_commands.cisco:
banner login #
Authorized access only. Disconnect immediately if not authorized.
#
fix_commands.fortinet:
config system replacemsg-group
 edit login
  set comment "Authorized access only."
 next
end
fix_commands.juniper: set system login announcement "Authorized access only."

name: Enable Logging
description: System logging must be enabled to support audit trails and incident response.

fix_commands.fortinet:
config log memory setting
 set status enable
end
fix_commands.juniper: set system syslog file messages any any

name: Configure Remote Syslog
description: Logs must be sent to a remote syslog server to prevent local tampering and support centralized monitoring.

fix_commands.fortinet:
config log syslogd setting
 set status enable
 set server <syslog-server-ip>
end
fix_commands.juniper: set system syslog host <syslog-server-ip> any any

name: Configure NTP
description: Network Time Protocol must be configured to ensure accurate timestamps for security logs and certificates.

fix_commands.fortinet:
config system ntp
 set ntpsyn enable
 set server <ntp-server-ip>
end

name: Use SNMPv3 Only
description: SNMPv1 and SNMPv2c transmit community strings in cleartext. Only SNMPv3 with authentication and encryption should be used.

fix_commands.cisco:
no snmp-server community public
snmp-server group SECURE v3 priv
snmp-server user ADMIN SECURE v3 auth sha <password> priv aes 256 <priv-password>
fix_commands.fortinet:
config system snmp community
 delete 1
end
config system snmp sysinfo
 set status enable
end
fix_commands.juniper:
delete snmp community public
set snmp v3 usm local-engine user admin authentication-md5 authentication-password <password>

name: Enable AAA Authentication
description: Authentication, Authorization, and Accounting (AAA) must be configured to centrally manage access control.

fix_commands.cisco:
aaa new-model
aaa authentication login default local
aaa authorization exec default local
fix_commands.fortinet:
config system admin
 edit admin
  set accprofile super_admin
 next
end
fix_commands.juniper:
set system authentication-order radius password
set access profile default authentication-order radius

name: Enable Password Encryption
description: All passwords stored in device configuration must be encrypted to prevent credential exposure.

fix_commands.fortinet: Fortinet encrypts passwords by default in FortiOS 6.0+. Verify admin password strength.

name: Disable IP Source Routing
description: IP source routing allows attackers to specify the route packets take, potentially bypassing security controls.

fix_commands.fortinet: Fortinet blocks source routing by default. No action required.

name: Disable Directed Broadcasts
description: IP directed broadcasts can be used to amplify DoS attacks (e.g., Smurf attacks). They must be disabled on all interfaces.

fix_commands.fortinet: Directed broadcasts are disabled by default in FortiOS.
fix_commands.juniper: set interfaces <interface> unit 0 family inet no-redirects

name: Configure Management ACL
description: Access to the device management plane (SSH, HTTPS) must be restricted by an Access Control List to trusted IP ranges only.

fix_commands.cisco:
ip access-list standard MGMT-ACCESS
 permit <trusted-ip-range>
line vty 0 15
 access-class MGMT-ACCESS in
fix_commands.fortinet:
config system interface
 edit mgmt
  set allowaccess ssh https
  set trust-ip-1 <trusted-ip/mask>
 next
end
fix_commands.juniper:
set firewall filter PROTECT-RE term MANAGEMENT from source-address <trusted-ip/prefix>
set firewall filter PROTECT-RE term MANAGEMENT then accept

name: Set Idle Session Timeout
description: Management sessions must automatically disconnect after a period of inactivity to prevent unauthorized access from unattended terminals.

fix_commands.cisco:
line vty 0 15
 exec-timeout 10 0
line console 0
 exec-timeout 10 0
fix_commands.fortinet:
config system global
 set admintimeout 10
end

name: Avoid Default SNMP Community Strings
description: Default SNMP community strings ('public' and 'private') are widely known and must not be used.

fix_commands.cisco:
no snmp-server community public
no snmp-server community private
fix_commands.fortinet:
config system snmp community
 delete 1
end
fix_commands.juniper:
delete snmp community public
delete snmp community private
